# Generated by "make docs" from the code and the translation catalogs.
title: "HTTP API"
weight: 25

Every operation of the HTTP API of the agent, generated from api/openapi.yaml, which the agent also serves at /api/v1/openapi.yaml. Requests need a session or an access token unless the role is public; the guide to the HTTP API explains roles and tokens.

Energy measurements of the node, its inference backends and models, served by the agent on its Unix socket and on 127.0.0.1:10060. Every document carries schema_version, which changes only when a field changes meaning or disappears. On the HTTP listener, any request can also be answered with 429 when its address sends too many, and with 413 when its body exceeds 1 MiB.

### GET /api/v1/audit

Actions of operators and administrators, newest first.

Role: `admin`

**Parameters**

| Name | In | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `limit` | query | integer | no | Most entries to return, 1 to 1000; 100 by default. |
| `before` | query | integer | no | Return entries older than the entry with this id. |

**Responses**

| Status | Description | Document |
|---|---|---|
| `200` | The audit log. | [Audit](#audit) |
| `400` | The request is not valid. | [Error](#error) |
| `401` | No valid session or token. | [Error](#error) |
| `403` | The role is not enough, or the CSRF check failed. | [Error](#error) |
| `500` | The agent could not complete the request; its log has the details. | [Error](#error) |

### GET /api/v1/stream

Live power and use of the backends as server-sent events. A sample event, whose data is a LivePoint and whose id grows by one with each sample, follows every sample of the agent; a backends event, whose data is a Backends document, follows every usage interval. A comment keeps the connection open every 15 seconds. A client that reconnects with Last-Event-ID receives the samples it missed while they are still in memory, at most 15 minutes. A client that falls behind is disconnected and resumes the same way.

Role: `viewer`

**Parameters**

| Name | In | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `Last-Event-ID` | header | integer | no | Id of the last sample received. |
| `last_event_id` | query | integer | no | Id of the last sample received, for clients that cannot set headers. |

**Responses**

| Status | Description | Document |
|---|---|---|
| `200` | The stream of events. |  |
| `401` | No valid session or token. | [Error](#error) |
| `503` | Too many live clients. | [Error](#error) |

### GET /api/v1/usage

Energy of a period, by channel or by backend, model or consumer. Without group_by, the energy of every channel in buckets. With group_by, the energy, tokens and requests of each backend, model or consumer.

Role: `viewer`

**Parameters**

| Name | In | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `from` | query | string (date-time) | yes | Start of the period, RFC 3339. |
| `to` | query | string (date-time) | yes | End of the period, RFC 3339, at most three years after from. |
| `bucket` | query | string | no | Size of each bucket, such as 1m or 1h, at least 1m. Without it, one total. |
| `group_by` | query | `backend`, `model`, `consumer` | no | Group by backend, model or consumer instead of by channel. |

**Responses**

| Status | Description | Document |
|---|---|---|
| `200` | Usage by channel, or by group when group_by is set. | [Usage](#usage) or [BackendUsage](#backendusage) |
| `400` | The request is not valid. | [Error](#error) |
| `401` | No valid session or token. | [Error](#error) |
| `500` | The agent could not complete the request; its log has the details. | [Error](#error) |
